name: firestore
description: Google Cloud Firestore: get, list and query documents with plain JSON values, create and update (agents opt-in), delete (node only)

nodes.title: Get document
nodes.description: Read one document by path (fields decoded to plain JSON)

path.description: Document path, e.g. users/u1 or users/u1/orders/o1

mask.description: Only return these field paths, e.g. ["name", "address.city"]

value_format.description: plain: JSON values (timestamps etc. as {"timestampValue": "..."}); typed: Firestore Value JSON such as {"stringValue": "x"}

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List documents
nodes.description: List the documents of a collection (or subcollection), paginated with next_cursor

collection_path.description: Collection path, e.g. users or users/u1/orders

mask.description: Only return these field paths, e.g. ["name", "address.city"]

value_format.description: plain: JSON values (timestamps etc. as {"timestampValue": "..."}); typed: Firestore Value JSON such as {"stringValue": "x"}

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Run query
nodes.description: Query a collection (or a collection group) with where filters (AND), order_by, select, limit and offset

collection_id.description: Collection id to query, e.g. orders

parent_path.description: Document path the collection lives under, e.g. users/u1 (default: the database root)

all_descendants.description: Collection group query: every collection with this id at any depth under the parent

select.description: Only return these field paths, e.g. ["name", "address.city"]

offset.description: Skip this many results (skipped documents are still billed as reads)

value_format.description: plain: JSON values (timestamps etc. as {"timestampValue": "..."}); typed: Firestore Value JSON such as {"stringValue": "x"}

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Create document
nodes.description: Create a document in a collection (with document_id, or an auto id); fails if it already exists (as an agent tool only when FIRESTORE_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1)

collection_path.description: Collection path, e.g. users or users/u1/orders

document_id.description: Document id (default: an auto id; with an id a retry cannot create a duplicate)

value_format.description: plain: JSON values (timestamps etc. as {"timestampValue": "..."}); typed: Firestore Value JSON such as {"stringValue": "x"}

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Update document
nodes.description: Update a document: merge (default) sets only the given top-level fields and removes delete_fields; merge false replaces the whole document (as an agent tool only when FIRESTORE_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1)

path.description: Document path, e.g. users/u1 or users/u1/orders/o1

merge.description: true: only the given top-level fields change; false: the document becomes exactly `fields`

must_exist.description: Fail with not found instead of creating the document

value_format.description: plain: JSON values (timestamps etc. as {"timestampValue": "..."}); typed: Firestore Value JSON such as {"stringValue": "x"}

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Delete document
nodes.description: Delete a document (its subcollections are not deleted); workflow nodes only

path.description: Document path, e.g. users/u1 or users/u1/orders/o1

must_exist.description: Fail with not found when the document does not exist

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
